scripts.assets: B=/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender; $B -b --factory-startup -P blender/buggy.py -- dist/assets && $B -b --factory-startup -P blender/props.py -- dist/assets && $B -b --factory-startup -P blender/textures.py -- dist/assets && $B -b --factory-startup -P blender/gate.py -- dist/assets
scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife '--define:import.meta.url="https://localhost/assets/"' --outfile=game.js && cp index.html game.js dist/
